description: This file provides an extension to the CanvasWindowController class, adding functionalities related to creating, presenting, repositioning, and managing the window or panel for a canvas presentation within a macOS application. It includes methods for window and panel setup, anchoring, repositioning, screen detection, frame constraints, and persistence of window positions.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSWindow or panel depending on the presentation style, setting appropriate properties like size, style, level, and content view.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Makes the panel visible, positions it using an anchor provider, activates the application, and brings the web view into focus.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Calculates the best position for the panel based on provided anchor, previous frame, screen, or mouse position, and applies agent placement overrides if any.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame for the panel within the visible bounds of the screen, constraining the frame if necessary, and persists the frame position.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Determines the appropriate NSScreen based on an anchor rectangle.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Returns the screen that contains the current mouse cursor position.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a given frame intersects with the visible area of the screen sufficiently.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Constrains a given frame to stay within the bounds of a visible frame, adjusting size and position accordingly.

methods.name: windowWillClose
methods.description: Handles the window closing event, updating visibility status.

methods.name: windowDidMove
methods.description: Handles the window move event, saving the new frame position.

methods.name: windowDidEndLiveResize
methods.description: Handles the resize end event, saving the new frame position.

methods.name: persistFrameIfPanel
methods.description: Stores the current window frame if it is a panel, for restoring later.
